plans.alternative: Into dominant magic damage, move Void Helm ahead of the physical-armor slot. Keep Basilisk third only when surviving is already reliable and physical allies need the shred. Aegis Of Agawar remains a late health-to-power payoff; it does not replace early base armor.

plans.counterplay: Kiting and disengage deny his contact; Dekker's control and fence can complicate the approach, though an available leap can cross terrain. plans.skill_reason: Make Way at one gives sustained area camp damage; Sacred Oath at two adds a cheap empowered cleave and slow, then Assault The Gates at three adds camp-leader-refunded travel and gank access. Max Make Way at 1/4/5/7/9 for damage and armor shred. Sacred Oath at 2/8/10/12/13 adds empowered damage and slow while remaining cheap. Leave the leap at 3/14/15/17/18; take it at two instead when safety or an early crossing demands it. Stone Forged Soul at 6/11/16. The 1.17 durability nerf does not change these rank functions. plans.reason: Retain the jungle farming opener followed by inexpensive control amplification and appropriate armor. Heavy Metal no longer pops spell shields with basic attacks. No current Steel-jungle role sample exists, so the recommendation rests on the verified kit and item roles, not an offlane rate repurposed as jungle evidence.
plans.role_economy_purchase_order: Fire Blossom gives persistent close-range camp damage before Dynamo's ally-damage window. Flux Matrix supports allied magic follow-up and adds magic defense. Those later defenses remain matchup-dependent. Do not copy the farming opener to low-income support or assume completing all six is routine.
plans.alternative: Move physical defense ahead of Flux Matrix against attack-heavy pressure, or keep Flux earlier for a relevant magic threat and allied follow-up. Tainted Guard is conditional on being attacked by a healing opponent; it is not global anti-heal. Do not select Unbroken Will for the disputed tenacity feed number.
plans.crest_augment_eternal_blessings: Saphir's Mantle, Krix and armor interact with a health/armor tank kit. Heavy Metal uses armor, not the removed spell-shield bug. Regenerative Tissue supports gaps between hero fights; Predator favors clearing a camp leader before a near-term gank rather than waiting out its buff.
plans.counterplay: Riktor's shield removal and silence are a threat to Steel's protection and next cast. Space the control chain and respect a spell shield before the key engage. Steel cannot treat magic armor as sufficient versus sustained physical attacks, nor can missing jungle matchup data be scored as a neutral win rate.
plans.team_fit: Shield Slam into Gideon's Black Hole is a concrete setup/follow-up chain; Bull Rush should not push caught enemies out of the zone. Dynamo and nearby Flux Matrix support that window. Hold Shield Bash or Bull Rush for an interrupting enemy when the initial catch is already secured.
plans.skill_reason: Shield Bash first for low-cost area damage, stun and explicit monster bonus; Bull Rush second adds another camp hit and access, Force Shield third gives projectile protection for the first skirmish. Max Shield Bash at 1/4/5/7/9, then Bull Rush at 2/8/10/12/13; Force Shield at 3/14/15/17/18. Shield Slam at 6/11/16. The old Omeda monster bonus is superseded by official 1.16.4; the schedule uses the existence of that bonus, not the outdated amount. Force Shield earlier ranks are an optional response to repeated projectile fights.
